# Multi Language OCR

> [!WARNING]
> This mod is deprecated: This mod is deprecated due to Papermerge, Paperless-ng and Paperless-ngx containers having been deprecated

This mod adds multi language OCR packages to papermerge and paperless-ng/x, to be installed/updated during container start. Keep in mind that you still have to enable the languages in the app itself, as this mod only installs the system language packs.

Add it to the `papermerge` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:papermerge-multilangocr
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:papermerge-multilangocr|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

In papermerge/paperless-ng/x docker arguments, set an environment variable `DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:papermerge-multilangocr` to enable this mod.

Then set an environment variable named `OCRLANG` and set it to the language codes that follow `tesseract-ocr-` from [this page](https://packages.ubuntu.com/focal/tesseract-ocr-all). You can add multiple codes that are comma separated, with no spaces.

For example, if you want to enable OCR for Chinese Simple and Belarusian, you'd set the var as `-e OCRLANG="chi-sim,bel"`.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/papermerge-multilangocr/
